collision.gradient_rule: plane gradient of the containing triangle; stored normal = normalize(-gx, 1, -gz)
collision.normal_rule: normalized cross(b-a, c-a) of the containing triangle on the stored render positions (graph_earth.hpp:100)

name: monkey_clearing_terrain

style.normal_rule: normalized cross(b-a, c-a) per triangle, duplicated flat-shaded vertices (hygiene gate passes untouched)

terrain_surface.diagonal_rule: cell (ix,iz) splits along node(ix,iz)-node(ix+1,iz+1); triangle A=(00,01,11) covers tz>=tx, triangle B=(00,11,10) covers tz<tx (tz = z-z_j, tx = x-x_i in metres)
terrain_surface.discretization_derivation: 2*(1/8)*A_max*pi^2/(2*R_min^2) with A_max=0.12, R_min=4.0, dx=dz=1 -> 0.00925 m; carried identically by render and collision projections
